verses.1: And these were the descendants of Israel who were scattered across the land of Canaan. They were scattered by Eleazar the priest and Yehoshua son of Nun, as well as the leaders of the tribes among the descendants of Israel.
verses.2: In their territory, they shall act as God commanded Moses: for nine parts and half a part.
verses.3: For Moses gave the land of the two tribes and half of the tribe of Judah as a territory. But he did not give any territory within those regions.
verses.4: For the sons of Joseph had two tribes: Manasseh and Ephraim. They were not given any land to live in, except for cities where they could settle down. And from their cities, they took away land for themselves and for their descendants.
verses.5: Just as Yahweh commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel. They divided up the land.
verses.6: And the children of Israel went to Joshua in the wilderness. They said to him, “Caleb, son of Jephunneh the Kenizite, you know what God has spoken to Moses about us and you too, in the holy place at Bethel.”
verses.7: At the age of forty, I was sent by Moses as a servant of Jehovah. I was taken from the holy place in Bethel to rule over this land. I will do whatever is in my heart.
verses.8: And my brothers who went up with me, they became the heart of the people. And I, I am filled with the spirit of Jehovah, my God.
verses.9: And Moses said on that day, “If the land you have walked on does not become a source of water for you, then it will remain a barren land forever. For you have come to this land through the command of the LORD, your God.”
verses.10: And now, behold, Jehovah has given me life again, just as it was said forty-five years ago, since Jehovah spoke these words to Moses. Moses went to Israel across the sea. And now, behold, I am today fifty-two years old.
verses.11: Today, I am as strong as I was on the day when Moses sent me out to fight. I am still as strong today, ready to go and to battle.
verses.12: And now, give me this mountain. For on that day, the LORD will speak through it. You heard those words that day: there were giants and great cities in that place. But the LORD will give me what He has promised, just as He said.
verses.13: And Joshua blessed him, and he gave his livestock to Jacob’s son Reuben as a portion of the land.
verses.14: Therefore, it became a home for the beautiful dog of Kenez. It remained there until today. This is because it was given by Jehovah, the God of Israel.
verses.15: And the name of that place was “Kriat” – four people who were tall, with giant arms. And that land was peaceful, free from war.
